title: Palais de verre miroir
intro: Xalaatal benn réew bu sori, bari alal ak rafetaay, fu ñuy jaamu jant bi, te duñu jaamu Ki ko sàkk. Dafa am bataaxal bu ànd ak woote bu kenn mënul baña déglu, ñu tàmbali tukki ci àttekaay bu gëna mag buñu musul gis. Foofu, njuumte dina feeñ ci dër buy nax bët yi, te ab diir bu leer dina soppi lépp.
clues: Maa ngi yoroon réew mu naataange gu nit ñi di sujjoot ci jant bi te bàyyi Yàlla.
Dama jot bataaxal bu baax bu may woo ma baña yékkati sama bopp waaye ma ñëw topp Yàlla.
Ma laaj sama konsilu ba noppi ma njëkka tànn diplomaasi, yónnee kado ngir natt ki ko yónnee.
Bima yeggee ci Sulayman, ñu wan ma sama jal buma degise ngir xam ndax xam nañu ma.
Ma dugg ci palaas bu kawe, dëru weer bu nooy bi ma jàpp ni ndox mu xóot la.
Maa ngi xamle sama jébbalu ak Sulaymaan ci Yàlla, Boroom àdduna yi.

outcome.answer: Toppal ak Sulaymaan ci Yàlla Boroom Àddina yi

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
